alignments.note: The verse opens asyndetically in the projection — ὅθεν carries no coordination — and no other source token licenses a clause-initial And, so it answers to nothing (rules 5, 86). The variant decision at SBLGNT.ACT.28.13.v017 concerns s002 alone and touches no connective, so this is not a rule 97 case.
ὅθεν → from thence; head on the adverbial thence.

The r01 participle περιελθόντες, converted into a coordinate finite clause with its supplied subject, is rendered by the support frame made a circuit. Head on the meaning-bearing complement circuit (rules 17, 91).
The supplied juncture and is a rule 88 helper on the finite verb it introduces. Head on arrived.
νότου → a south wind, the supplied determiner riding along (rule 7). Head on the noun wind.
Genitive absolute participle converted into a finite clause; the particle up realizes the preverb of ἐπιγίνομαι and rides inside the unit, headed on the verb word sprang (rule 106).
Anarthrous substantival adjective expanded with a supplied determiner and generic noun; rule 17's generic-noun clause is in force because no Greek article stands, so the head is the adjective second.
The supplied juncture and is a rule 88 helper on the finite verb it introduces; the unit is discontinuous around the fronted temporal phrase (rule 15). Head on came.

review_notes: SBLGNT.ACT.28.13.v017 is selected to r01, which supplies περιελθόντες; the ASV's made a circuit answers to it, so no token is stranded and the ASV's textual note (Some ancient authorities read cast loose) records only the rejected reading.
The verse-initial And is the one added unit; it is licensed by no source token in this verse or a neighbouring one.
